answer: Use an arrival spacing admission gate: new agents must sit through a tundra quiet period of randomized first-action delays before normal traffic is accepted. The gate compares each cohort’s request timing to the live population’s echo shape, rejecting identities whose bursts arrive too evenly or too fast and forcing later retries. An attacker pays 12 idle queue hours and 1,000 paced probes per identity, while a juniper seed rotates the retry ceiling so batching earns no discount.
